about: The symbols the old game showed from the system's fonts, drawn by the engine as icons (GM1-7, Q12; Docs/Game/Foundation.md, "The symbols as vector icons (GM1-7)"). Each outline is one or more filled paths with their fill rule, in units of 1/1000 em, x from the pen position, y down from the baseline; it is filled in the text's colour. Each icon's box is the glyph Chromium drew for the symbol on the reference PC, in em: its advance, and its font's ascent, descent and line gap as Chromium reads them (OS/2's typo metrics when USE_TYPO_METRICS is set, else hhea's); "measured" names that font, its file in Tests/Statventure.Tests/Data/SystemFonts and how it was found. Written by Tools/IconSheet/gen/build.py with the outlines; Tools/Scripts/make-icon-sheet.sh shows them.
